title: Smoky Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken dish inspired by Moroccan cuisine, slow-cooked in a smoky tagine.

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Add the Moroccan spice mix, smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and reduce heat to low. Simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with couscous, rice, or crusty bread for a filling meal.
